verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 12.41
verses.english: Linked Discourses 12.41

verses.pali: 5. Gahapativagga
verses.english: 5. Householders

verses.pali: Pañcaverabhayasutta
verses.english: Fears and Enmities

verses.pali: Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṁ gahapatiṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the Buddha said to the householder Anāthapiṇḍika:

verses.pali: “Yato kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṁ byākareyya:
verses.english: “Householder, when a noble disciple has quelled five fears and enmities, possesses the four factors of stream-entry, and has clearly seen and penetrated the noble system with wisdom, they may, if they wish, declare of themselves:

verses.pali: ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano’ti.
verses.english: ‘I’ve finished with rebirth in hell, the animal realm, and the ghost realm. I’ve finished with all places of loss, bad places, the underworld. I am a stream-enterer! I’m not liable to be reborn in the underworld, and am assured, destined for awakening.’

verses.pali: Katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti?
verses.english: What are the five fears and enmities they have quelled?

verses.pali: Yaṁ, gahapati, pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedayati, pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṁ taṁ bhayaṁ veraṁ vūpasantaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Anyone who kills living creatures brims with fear and enmity both in this life and in lives to come, and experiences mental pain and sadness. That fear and enmity is quelled for anyone who refrains from killing living creatures.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, gahapati, adinnādāyī adinnādānapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedayati, adinnādānā paṭiviratassa evaṁ taṁ bhayaṁ veraṁ vūpasantaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Anyone who steals brims with fear and enmity both in this life and in lives to come, and experiences mental pain and sadness. That fear and enmity is quelled for anyone who refrains from stealing.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, gahapati, kāmesumicchācārī kāmesumicchācārapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedayati, kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratassa evaṁ taṁ bhayaṁ veraṁ vūpasantaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Anyone who commits sexual misconduct brims with fear and enmity both in this life and in lives to come, and experiences mental pain and sadness. That fear and enmity is quelled for anyone who refrains from committing sexual misconduct.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, gahapati, musāvādī musāvādapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedayati, musāvādā paṭiviratassa evaṁ taṁ bhayaṁ veraṁ vūpasantaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Anyone who lies brims with fear and enmity both in this life and in lives to come, and experiences mental pain and sadness. That fear and enmity is quelled for anyone who refrains from lying.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, gahapati, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānapaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṁ veraṁ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ paṭisaṁvedayati, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evaṁ taṁ bhayaṁ veraṁ vūpasantaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Anyone who consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants brims with fear and enmity both in this life and in lives to come, and experiences mental pain and sadness. That fear and enmity is quelled for anyone who refrains from consuming beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
verses.english: These are the five fears and enmities they have quelled.

verses.pali: Katamehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti?
verses.english: What are the four factors of stream-entry that they possess?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
verses.english: It’s when a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha:

verses.pali: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṁ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavā’ti.
verses.english: ‘That Blessed One is perfected, a fully awakened Buddha, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, holy, knower of the world, supreme guide for those fit for training, teacher of gods and humans, awakened, blessed.’

verses.pali: Dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
verses.english: They have experiential confidence in the teaching:

verses.pali: ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṁ veditabbo viññūhī’ti.
verses.english: ‘The teaching is well explained by the Buddha—apparent in the present life, immediately effective, inviting inspection, relevant, so that sensible people can know it for themselves.’

verses.pali: Saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
verses.english: They have experiential confidence in the Saṅgha:

verses.pali: ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṁ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṁ puññakkhettaṁ lokassā’ti.
verses.english: ‘The Saṅgha of the Buddha’s disciples is practicing the way that’s good, direct, systematic, and proper. It consists of the four pairs, the eight individual persons. This is the Saṅgha of the Buddha’s disciples that is worthy of offerings dedicated to the gods, worthy of hospitality, worthy of a religious donation, worthy of greeting with cupped palms, and is the supreme field of merit for the world.’

verses.pali: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: And a noble disciple’s ethical conduct is loved by the noble ones, unbroken, impeccable, spotless, and unmarred, liberating, praised by sensible people, not mistaken, and leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti.
verses.english: These are the four factors of stream-entry that they possess.

verses.pali: Katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho?
verses.english: And what is the noble system that they have clearly seen and penetrated with wisdom?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṁ yoniso manasi karoti:
verses.english: A noble disciple carefully and rationally applies the mind to dependent origination itself:

verses.pali: ‘iti imasmiṁ sati idaṁ hoti, imasmiṁ asati idaṁ na hoti;
verses.english: ‘When this exists, that comes to be; when this doesn’t exist, that is not.

verses.pali: imassuppādā idaṁ uppajjati, imassa nirodhā idaṁ nirujjhati.
verses.english: Due to the arising of this, that arises; due to the cessation of this, that ceases.

verses.pali: Yadidaṁ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā;
verses.english: Ignorance is a requirement for choices.

verses.pali: saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṁ …pe…
verses.english: Choices are a requirement for consciousness. …

verses.pali: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.

verses.pali: Avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho;
verses.english: When ignorance fades away and ceases with no residue left behind, choices cease.

verses.pali: saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho …pe…
verses.english: When choices cease, consciousness ceases. …

verses.pali: evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.’

verses.pali: Ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
verses.english: This is the noble system that they have clearly seen and penetrated with wisdom.

verses.pali: Yato kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ayañcassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṁ byākareyya:
verses.english: When a noble disciple has quelled five fears and enmities, possesses the four factors of stream-entry, and has clearly seen and penetrated the noble system with wisdom, they may, if they wish, declare of themselves:

verses.pali: ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano’”ti.
verses.english: ‘I’ve finished with rebirth in hell, the animal realm, and the ghost realm. I’ve finished with all places of loss, bad places, the underworld. I am a stream-enterer! I’m not liable to be reborn in the underworld, and am assured, destined for awakening.’”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
